WEALTH-TAX RULES
WEALTH-TAX RULES
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 19th October 1963]
S. R. O. 788(x)/63.-In exercise of the powers conferred by section
46 of the Wealth -tax Act, 1963 (XV of 1963), the Central Board of Revenue
hereby makes the following rules, namely-----
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) These rules may be called
the Wealth-tax Rules.
(2) They shall be deemed to have come into force on and from the
first day of July 1963.
2, Definitions.-In these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires,
(a) "the act" means the Wealth-tax Act, 1963 ;
(b) "Form" means Form appended to these rules ;
(c) "section" means section of the Wealth-tax Act, 1963.
3. Return of Net Wealth.-(a) The return of net wealth referred to
in subsections (1) and (2) of section 14 shall, in the case of individuals and
Hindu undivided families, be in Form A, and in the case of companies, in Form B
annexed to this rule.
(b) Where the assessee is carrying on a business, a copy of the
balance-sheet or trial balance as on the valuation date or on the date of the
closing of accounts immediately preceding the valuation date, and a copy of the
auditor's report, if any, shall also be furnished along with the return of net
Wealth.
